r.s: An implementation of the SMTP protocol
r.d: Provides an implementation of the SMTP protocol using PEAR's Net_Socket class.
r.n: * BugFix: (authXOAuth2) longer tokens violate maximum SMTP command line length #70 * BugFix: (disconnect) socket will not disconnect on erroneous response upon QUIT message #71 * BugFix: Fix PHP 8.2 deprecation warnings on undefined properties #72
